claims.scope: HypoVault first deposit share minting against pre-set totalSupply

preconditions.text: The HypoVault constructor sets totalSupply to 1,000,000 without minting any shares.; balanceOf is an empty mapping, so the sum of balances is 0 while totalSupply is 1,000,000.; The first deposit is 1,000 assets.
preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。

safety.text: ERC-20 invariant should hold: totalSupply must equal the sum of all balances at all times.; Shares should be minted only in proportion to deposited assets, without pre-minted unbacked supply.
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。

effects.text: The first depositor receives 1000x more shares than warranted for 1,000 assets.
effects.derivation: 该影响保留在覆盖清单中，但未生成形式化谓词。
